items.title: What Does Verizon Communications (VZ) Gain From Its New Motorsport IoT Partnership?
items.summary: Verizon Communications (NYSE:VZ) has partnered with Bosch Motorsport to provide global IoT connectivity for race events via its ThingSpace platform. The collaboration centralizes management of race-day sensors worldwide so Bosch Motorsport can run devices under a single orchestration layer. ThingSpace connectivity is designed to support data handling for rules compliance and safety monitoring in high-pressure international motorsport settings.
